title: Kissed Earthy Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A hearty and comforting Algerian dish featuring tender vegetables in a rich and creamy sauce, cooked to perfection in a traditional tagine pot. This lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe showcases the flavors of North Africa.
instructions: Heat the rendered fat in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots, zucchini, and bell pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the paprika and salt.
Add the canned diced tomatoes and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chilled full fat sour cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce is heated through.
